description: Na₄RuN₆H₂O₁₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.60 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids,  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid, and edges with two equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.66 Å. Ru is bonded to six N atoms to form RuN₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃N trigonal pyramids. There are four shorter (2.08 Å) and two longer (2.09 Å) Ru-N bond lengths. There are three inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Ru and two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.26 Å) and one longer (1.27 Å) N-O bond length. In the second N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Ru and two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.26 Å) and one longer (1.27 Å) N-O bond length. In the third N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Ru and two O atoms. Both N-O bond lengths are 1.26 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one N atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one N atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na and one N atom to form distorted ONa₃N trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one RuN₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃N trigonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 59°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent H atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one N atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one N atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one N atom.
